parsed.reason: Description A says days are split into multiple groups because timestamps with mixed UTC offsets make local dates non-monotonic in sort order, so the same day appears non-adjacent. Description B says quantity is never reset after yielding, so totals are running sums across days. The code shows quantity is reset nowhere, but the reset is not missing from the tracking; the real issue in B is a missing reset, while A is about grouping by non-UTC dates. Different root causes, even though both lie in daily_totals.
